title: French Pea Soufflé
description: A light and airy soufflé infused with the sweetness of peas, perfect for a dinner party. This recipe serves as a delightful dessert or side dish.
instructions: Butter a 1-quart soufflé dish and coat with granulated sugar.
In a medium saucepan, combine the peas, sour cream, and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt until light and airy.
Add the softened butter to the egg mixture and whisk until well combined.
Fold the pea mixture into the egg mixture until no white streaks remain.
Pour the mixture into the prepared soufflé dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
